Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAW.en: Come see me in a while.
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAW.fr: Reviens me voir dans un moment.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonF.en: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonF.fr: Très bien, je m'occuperai de ton\n{STR_VAR_1} pendant un moment.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownBy.en: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownBy.fr: Ton {STR_VAR_1} a beaucoup grandi.\nOui, beaucoup, je dirais.\pVoyons voir…\nEn niveaux, il a gagné {STR_VAR_2}.\pJe suis génial, non ?

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpe.en: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpe.fr: Déjà de retour ?\pTon {STR_VAR_1} doit passer\nencore un peu de temps avec moi.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMo.en: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMo.fr: Oh ? Tu n'as qu'un seul POKéMON\navec toi.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMons.en: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMons.fr: Tu me dois {STR_VAR_2} ¥ pour le retour\nde ce POKéMON.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_PlayerGotMonB.fr: {PLAYER} a repris {STR_VAR_1}\nau GARDIEN DE LA PENSION.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaise.en: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaise.fr: Je tiens la PENSION.\pVeux-tu que j'élève un de tes\nPOKéMON ?

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBa.en: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBa.fr: Si tu me laisses ce POKéMON,\navec quoi vas-tu te battre ?

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoo.en: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.
Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoo.fr: Tu ne peux pas reprendre ce POKéMON\nsi tu n'as pas de place.
